description: Search the PikaSim eSIM catalog (data eSIMs and phone-number eSIMs) by free-text query and/or ISO country code. Returns a list of matching plans, each with an id, a title (name + price), and a pikasim.com URL. Pass an id to the fetch tool for full details. Read-only.

query.description: Free-text search, may include a country name and/or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. "Japan 10GB", "US phone plan", "DE")

name: search
